title: J. Wood Capital Advisors selects Intapp DealCloud to support relationship management and business development efforts
summary: J. Wood Capital Advisors selects Intapp DealCloud to bring AI-driven deal management to convertible debt placement — leveraging governed agentic AI and Intapp Firm AI to bring AI-driven deal management to convertible debt placement.
body_markdown:
**PALO ALTO, Calif. — November 18, 2026** — Intapp (NASDAQ: INTA), the governed AI platform for professional firms in highly regulated industries, today announced that J. Wood Capital Advisors (JWCA), an independent capital structure advisory firm specializing in convertible debt and related financing transactions, has selected Intapp DealCloud as its relationship management and business development platform. JWCA will use DealCloud to support origination, manage key relationships, centralize institutional knowledge, and coordinate business development activities across its growing network of corporate issuers, investors, referral partners, and other strategic advisors.


Relationships are central to JWCA’s advisory business. The firm works closely with management teams, boards of directors, investors, banks, and other market participants throughout the lifecycle of a financing transaction. As the business has grown, the firm recognized the need for a purpose-built platform to centralize relationship intelligence, improve internal collaboration, and support business development efforts across the organization.


After evaluating available solutions, JWCA selected DealCloud for its focus on the unique needs of investment banking and advisory firms. The platform will provide centralized relationship intelligence, opportunity tracking, and business development activity, helping professionals stay coordinated as they manage relationships across the firm’s expanding network of clients, prospects, referral partners, investors, and other market participants.


JWCA selected DealCloud to establish a scalable foundation for relationship management and business development, with plans to evaluate additional capabilities across the broader Intapp platform over time. The firm’s immediate priorities include improving opportunity tracking, coordinating workflows, and strengthening institutional knowledge management.
